query: Which material can be used for enhanced catalytic activity and durability toward HER and HOR, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) can be used for enhanced catalytic activity and durability toward Hydrogen Evolution Reaction (HER) and Hydrogen Oxidation Reaction (HOR).
generation.structural_mediator: Active sites on the surface of TMDCs
generation.mechanism: Modulation of the electronic structure and surface properties
generation.baseline: Pristine TMDCs without doping or defect engineering
generation.boundary: Limited by the stability of TMDCs in harsh environments
generation.uncertainty: The extent of improvement depends on the specific TMDC material, doping or defect engineering method, and environmental conditions

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the catalytic activity and durability of pristine and doped/defect-engineered TMDCs in HER and HOR
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the doped/defect-engineered TMDCs do not show significantly improved catalytic activity and durability compared to pristine TMDCs, the hypothesis is falsified
